title: Berlin Landmarks in 2 Hours - Quick Summary
items: **Pick east or west before you open a route.** Museum Island and Brandenburg Gate are two useful starting windows, not one quick loop.
**Use east from Alexanderplatz or Hackescher Markt.** Keep Museum Island outdoors unless one specific museum or cathedral interior is worth the time.
**Use west from Pariser Platz or the government quarter.** Let the Brandenburg Gate lead to the Reichstag exterior instead of adding a cross-city list.
**Make only one indoor commitment.** A museum, cathedral or registered Reichstag dome visit needs current entry information and should replace, not join, another interior.
Use the Berlin Landmark Window to place a focused two-hour frame around the landmark closest to you and see what not to add.
